# Victory Skating (VSA)

> Online figure skating academy (VSA) running live off-ice group classes and private lessons with international coaches, for skaters anywhere in the world. This file and the pages it links are generated from a catalog curated from the merchant's own pages and checkout; it supersedes older or deleted pages.

Facts that apply to every program:

- Programs are recurring with rolling enrollment — join any day. A start date printed on a landing page names the next session at the time of editing; it is not a deadline.
- Every package also shows a struck-through former price; quote the current price.
- Every package is a subscription billed every 6 months until cancelled.
- Refund policy: Non-refundable.

## Programs

- [6-Month Axel Club](https://vsa-ai-gateway.onrender.com/programs/axel-club.md): Level 1, Axel (1A). $299 billed every 6 months until cancelled (auto-renews). Every weekend (Saturday and Sunday), 07:00–07:45 America/Los_Angeles time (45-minute live classes, 2 per week). Instructors: Diana.

Every weekend (Saturday and Sunday), 08:00–08:45 America/Los_Angeles time (45-minute live classes, 2 per week). Instructors: Diana, Marta.
- [6-Month Double Axel Club](https://vsa-ai-gateway.onrender.com/programs/double-axel-club.md): Level 3, Double Axel (2A). $299 billed every 6 months until cancelled (auto-renews). Every weekend (Saturday and Sunday), 07:00–07:45 America/Los_Angeles time (45-minute live classes, 2 per week). Instructors: Marta.
- [6-Month Triple Jumps Club](https://vsa-ai-gateway.onrender.com/programs/triple-jumps-club.md): Level 4, Triple jumps (3S, 3T, 3Lo, 3F, 3Lz). $299 billed every 6 months until cancelled (auto-renews). ## Program

Level 1 of the VSA jump ladder. Focuses on mastering the Axel with proper technique, power and control: correct takeoff mechanics, safe rotation and a strong landing position off the ice, building a clean foundation for future double jumps.

- **Technique development:** Proper entry positions and takeoff technique; Pre-rotation and lift; Controlled landings to prevent injury
- **Power and explosiveness:** Plyometric training; Bounding drills; Core strengthening
- **Rotational speed:** Off-ice spins; Double-revolution drills
- **Progression:** Gradually harder drills; Transition towards double jumps

**You need:** Sneakers, Jump rope, Off-ice spinner, Stable internet connection, Some space to jump.

- 2 live group classes every weekend (Saturday and Sunday, 45 minutes each)
- 48 live group classes over 6 months

- Structured progression for 6 full months

## Program

Level 3 of the VSA jump ladder. For skaters who are already proficient in double jumps off-ice and want to make the transition to the Double Axel off-ice, and to prepare for triple jumps. Classes are live and interactive and run from home; the program progresses from technique fundamentals through power, rotational speed and harder drills over six months.

- **Technique development:** Correct approach and setup for a successful jump; Generating the rotation and height the Double Axel needs; Precise landings for stability and lower injury risk
- **Power and explosiveness:** Plyometric training for takeoff strength; Bounding drills that mimic the Double Axel's explosive energy; Core strengthening to stabilise the rotation axis
- **Rotational speed:** Off-ice spins for rotational control and speed; Double-revolution drills to build muscle memory
- **Progression:** Starts with basic drills and increases difficulty as technique improves; Moves into more complex drills and introduces the transition to harder double jumps and triple jumps

**You need:** Sneakers, Jump rope, Off-ice spinner, Stable internet connection, Some space to jump.

## Instructors

- **Coach Marta** (Saturday and Sunday). Figure skating coach with international experience as both a skater and a coach. Trained at MKS Axel Toruń in Poland and with Team Mayer-Virtanen in Finland. Holds a degree in Physical Education. $60/hour for private lessons.

## Try it free

- Over 800 skaters reached their 2Axel — many in under 12 weeks.
